settings.language.note: Translations other than English are machine translated and may contain mistakes.
empty.title: Open something to start
empty.body: Somnia works on your own files. Open a project folder, open a single file, or start a blank page. You can also drag files from your file manager into this window.
empty.hint: Ctrl+O opens a folder, Ctrl+K shows all commands.
cmd.split.vertical: Split: code and design side by side
cmd.table.insert: Insert table (3 x 3, header row, caption)
cmd.edit.wrap: Wrap selected element in a div
set.title: Settings
set.description: Personal editor settings. Project source and canvas colors are unchanged.
set.sc.intro: Click Change, then press the new keys. Esc cancels. Dreamweaver-style defaults such as Ctrl+D (duplicate), Ctrl+` (code/design) and F4 (hide panels) are included.
set.upd.intro: Installed: release v{release} (app {app}). Somnia checks GitHub Releases when it starts (switch off below) or when you press the button, and sends no data about you.
set.upd.never: No automatic check has run yet.
set.upd.auto: Check for updates on start, every 30 minutes and on window focus
set.upd.oneclick: One-click install inside the app needs a signed update channel (Tauri updater). It is planned in ADR-004 and not active yet, so updates are a download and run for now.
set.about.version: release v{release}, app {app}. A local-first visual editor for HTML and CSS.
set.about.license: Licensed under the MIT License. Copyright (c) 2026 Philipp Paulik. Source:
set.about.shadcn: Includes UI code derived from shadcn/ui (MIT). Full license texts ship with each package in its source.
set.ext.intro: Extensions add commands, snippets and code themes. Paste a manifest to install it. Installed: {count}.
set.ap.contrast.note: Higher contrast strengthens surfaces, borders and focus indicators.
set.ap.accent.ratio: Contrast of the accent against panels: {ratio}:1
set.ap.accent.low: . Below 3:1, so focus rings and selections may be hard to see. Pick a darker or lighter colour.
set.ap.accent.good: . Good for focus rings and selections.
set.ce.lint: Show syntax problems in the code gutter
set.ce.syntax.note: Syntax colors only. Source content and undo history are unchanged.
set.components.note: HTML blocks and a personal source library are available in the Components panel. Stored in this app profile only, not synced.
set.connections.note: Web-local bridge and GitHub connections are planned. No account or folder connection is created by these settings.
redesign.liveHint: Runs project JavaScript in a sandbox without filesystem access. Turn off to edit without running scripts.
redesign.motionHint: Only affects the Somnia interface. Project animations are unchanged. System follows your operating system preference.
redesign.startupHint: Restores local unsaved drafts only, not disk folders. Choosing another start screen keeps your existing recovery draft until you edit a new project.
redesign.draftHint: Saves memory-only project recovery data on this device. Does not write disk project files. Turning this off reduces crash recovery protection.
redesign.channelHint: Stable includes published stable releases. Beta also includes pre-releases except alpha/nightly builds. Alpha includes all pre-releases. Pre-release installation opens the download page; signed in-app installation stays on the stable endpoint.
redesign.fastHint: Uses incremental parsing where supported, with full parsing as a fallback. Turning this off uses full parsing for every edit.
redesign.signedUpdate: Desktop one-click updates verify signed stable packages before installation. Use the update pill when a newer stable version is available.
docPref.newOnly: These defaults are written into new blank HTML pages. Existing projects and local font files are not changed. Available fonts depend on your operating system.
docPref.exportHint: Applied to ZIP and single HTML downloads. Folder copies preserve the original project files. Cleaning creates a copy and does not change your source.
docPref.stripIds: Remove editor data attributes on export
backup.hint: Whole-project recovery snapshots are stored in this app profile, not a disk backup folder. Memory-only autosave records snapshots when enabled. Total storage is limited to 2 MB; older snapshots are removed to stay within the limit. Export large projects for an independent backup.
backup.restoreConfirm: Replace the current workspace with this snapshot? Unsaved workspace changes will be replaced. Original disk files are not modified.
close.title: You have unsaved changes
close.descDisk: Save them to your folder before closing, or discard them. Discarded edits stay in recovery and can be restored when you reopen the folder.
close.descMemory: This project is not saved to a folder. Keep a draft to restore it the next time Somnia starts, or discard it.
closeProject.title: Close this project?
closeProject.desc: It is not saved to a folder yet. Save it first, or discard the changes.
save.title: Save project
save.desc_one: {name} has {count} file and is not saved anywhere yet. Choose where to save them. Nothing is overwritten. Somnia then keeps that folder saved automatically.
save.desc_other: {name} has {count} files and is not saved anywhere yet. Choose where to save them. Nothing is overwritten. Somnia then keeps that folder saved automatically.
save.newFolder: Create a new folder named {name} inside the chosen folder
export.title: Export project
export.desc: Make a copy of {name}. Your open project and its save state stay as they are.
export.folderDesc: Copy all files into a folder on disk. Existing files are never overwritten.
export.singleDesc: One page with local CSS and scripts inlined.
export.markdownDesc: The page text as a .md file.
export.noHtml: This project has no HTML page.
export.needFolder: Folder export needs the desktop app or a browser with folder access.
ctx.mergeCell: Table: merge cell with right neighbour
ctx.flexApplied: Applied a flex layout rule to {tag}. Undo reverts it.
status.storageTab: working copy in this tab, not on disk
status.storageMemory: in memory only, not on disk
update.noSigned: This release has no signed one-click update yet. Opening the download page instead.
update.failed: One-click update failed: {error}. Opening the download page instead.
share.title: Work together
share.desc: Share this project or join someone else's.
share.hostIntro: Others can edit this project with you at the same time. Your files stay on your computer. Only you save to disk.
share.lan: Allow people on my local network (otherwise only this computer)
share.liveLan: Sharing is on for your local network. Send one of these links to a person you trust. Anyone with a link can join until it runs out.
share.liveLocal: Sharing is on on this computer only. Send one of these links to a person you trust. Anyone with a link can join until it runs out.
share.lanWarning: Links on a local network are not encrypted yet. Use them on a network you trust.
share.allowedView: You are allowed to: view only.
share.pasteHint: Paste the invite link the host sent you.
share.invalidLink: That does not look like a Somnia invite link.
share.insecure: This link is not encrypted. Only join on a network you trust.
